description: An open toy kitchen cabinet shelf is in front, holding several small clear plastic food containers and a green-lidded tub, with a tabletop area to the right. The left hand stays low near the table while the right hand reaches into the cabinet, lifts one clear container off the stack and sets it on the tabletop, then removes the green-lidded tub and places it beside the first container, and finally pulls out the remaining clear containers one by one and lays them out on the table, unstacking them into separate pieces.
